newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-MIAMI ACQUIRES MASHBURN FROM DALLAS FOR THREE PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-MIAMI ACQUIRES MASHBURN FROM DALLAS FOR THREE PLAYERS.

text.p: The Miami Heat, looking to stay atop the Atlantic Division, added some scoring punch on Friday by acquiring small forward Jamal Mashburn from the Dallas Mavericks for three players.
The Mavericks said they shipped Mashburn to the Heat in exchange for guard Sasha Danilovic and forwards Kurt Thomas and Martin Muresepp.
The deal was the first for Dallas under new General Manager Don Nelson, who was named to the post February 7.

The trade marked the second year in a row that Miami coach Pat Riley pulled off a big deal shortly before the trading dealine. Last season, Riley acquired star point guard Tim Hardaway from Golden State in a multi-player trade.
The acquisition of Mashburn gives Miami, which holds a two-game lead over the New York Knicks, another scoring option in the frontcourt.

Miami centre Alonzo Mourning is averaging 19.4 points per game. But with small forward Dan Majerle out for the season with a back injury, forwards P.J. Brown and Keith Askins have combined to average less than 14 points per game.
The National Basketball Association trading deadline is February 20.
